Title: General availability: Azure App Service Web Apps custom-domain capability

Body.Content: We’re partnering with GoDaddy to simplify the process of purchasing and managing custom domains. Now Azure App Service Web Apps customers can add custom domains to their Azure App Service Web Apps account and manage them within the same portal where they manage their web subscriptions. The top-level domains available are .com, .net, .co.uk, .org, .nl, .in, .biz, .org.uk, and .co.in. For more information, please visit the Buy and configure a custom domain name in Azure App Service documentation page.
